description: Normative fact-export-v1 schema for the sessions table. Carries the keyed session-to-trace link identifier (agent.session.link_id from link-id-v1) or an explicit unlinked_reason, canonical harness identity, lifecycle timestamps, and parent-child lineage.

agent.session.link_id.description: Keyed session-to-trace join identifier per link-id-v1 (64-char lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256) or the exact literal 'unlinked'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Never null and never guessed. Resolves to literal 'unlinked' with a required non-null unlinked_reason whenever any link-id-v1 input or key is invalid or origin is non-harness.
x_justification.pseudonymization: 256-bit HMAC-SHA256 tag under team/epoch-scoped K_link (DE-006, F6); computationally indistinguishable from random without K_link.
x_justification.why_present: Joins exported dendro session facts to OpenObserve trace spans on column agent_session_link_id without storing spans in Enterprise.
x_justification.zero_content: Cryptographic HMAC tag or fixed literal 'unlinked'; contains no prompt, path, or email (DE-004).

canonical_harness.description: Normalized harness identifier from the closed link-id-v1 vocabulary, or 'unknown' when unresolvable.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Uses explicit 'unknown' enum variant (accompanied by agent.session.link_id = 'unlinked' and unlinked_reason = 'missing_harness' or 'unknown_harness').
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 6-token enum vocabulary (F12); not a user or workspace identifier.
x_justification.why_present: Normalizes harness names across AOB ('claude-code') and dendro ('claude') per F12 and prevents provider-name misattribution (#29).

ended_at_us.description: Session end timestamp in UTC microseconds since Unix epoch when observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Null when timestamp_status is 'start_only' or 'not_observable' (e.g. active session). Must be non-null and >= started_at_us when timestamp_status is 'complete'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Numeric epoch timestamp; no identifier material.
x_justification.why_present: Bounds session duration and supports time-window cohort filtering and replacement when an active session completes.

endpoint_scope.description: Jointly provisioned, persistent endpoint namespace slug shared by AOB and dendro on the workstation or runner.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required provisioned slug on exported bundles; never a transient daemon PID or ingestion generation.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Opaque administrative endpoint namespace slug provisioned by the org (link-id-v1 §5.1); never a hostname, username, or filesystem path.
x_justification.why_present: Prevents cross-machine session ID collisions while keeping AOB and dendro link derivation deterministic.
x_justification.zero_content: Printable ASCII administrative slug without spaces, paths, or emails (DE-004).

harness_version.description: Observed harness version token (e.g. '2.1.322', '0.167.0') when reported by the source.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff harness_version_status == 'observed'; null iff harness_version_status == 'not_reported'. Never defaults to a fabricated version.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Public software release version token.
x_justification.why_present: Required for version-keyed native mapping equivalence (A4) and cohort comparability across harness upgrades.
x_justification.zero_content: Strict alphanumeric version token; no paths or command-line flags (DE-004).

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Explicitly distinguishes an observed version from an unreported version.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 2-value status enum.
x_justification.why_present: Prevents null ambiguity on harness_version.

is_root.description: True when the session is a root session with no evidenced parent session; false for child/delegated sessions.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required boolean paired with lineage_status ('root', 'evidenced', 'absent', 'truncated', 'conflict').
x_justification.pseudonymization: Boolean structural flag.
x_justification.why_present: Separates inclusive root totals from exclusive child totals so descendants are never double-counted in fleet rollups (I03, accounting_v1).

lineage_relation.description: Parent-to-child relationship kind from session_edges, or 'root' for root sessions.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Uses 'root' when is_root is true and 'unknown' when lineage_status is 'absent', 'truncated', or 'conflict'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed enum vocabulary from DATA_DICTIONARY.md §3.9.
x_justification.why_present: Supports subgraph token rollups (I03) and delegation depth analysis (I09) in Enterprise.

lineage_status.description: Evidence status of the parent-child session link per DATA_DICTIONARY.md §5.1.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Only 'evidenced' edges are traversed for inclusive subgraph reachability; 'absent', 'truncated', and 'conflict' explicitly record incomplete or conflicting lineage.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed enum vocabulary.
x_justification.why_present: Prevents unverified or conflicting parent links from corrupting inclusive token and cost rollups (I03).

link_epoch.description: Key rotation epoch slug used to derive K_link when agent.session.link_id is linked.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-null when agent.session.link_id != 'unlinked'; null only when unlinked due to invalid_key_material.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Administrative key epoch identifier (e.g. '2026-Q4') per link-id-v1 §6.
x_justification.why_present: Enables bounded dual-epoch overlap window joins and post-compromise epoch retirement.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-empty ASCII slug on every exported row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Organization tenant slug bound into link-id-v1 LP payload.
x_justification.why_present: Binds exported facts to the customer organization boundary (EN3a).

origin.description: Origin classification of the session record per link-id-v1 §5.3.4.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Explicitly distinguishes real 'harness' sessions from 'synthetic' test/collision frames or 'unknown' origins.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 3-value enum.
x_justification.why_present: Enforces D3 and link-id-v1 §5.3.4: non-harness origins MUST resolve to agent.session.link_id = 'unlinked' with unlinked_reason = 'non_harness_origin'.

parent_session_key.description: Pseudonymized session_key of the parent session when lineage_status == 'evidenced'.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null iff is_root == false and lineage_status == 'evidenced'; null when is_root == true or lineage is 'absent', 'truncated', or 'conflict'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym under pseudonym_key_id (F13); never a raw parent session UUID.
x_justification.why_present: Provides the parent-to-child graph edge for inclusive root token/cost rollups (I03).

pseudonym_key_id.description: Identifier of the customer-held HMAC key used to pseudonymize entity keys in this row.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-empty key identifier on every row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Identifies which customer-held key produced the 64-hex pseudonyms (DE-004, F13) without exposing key bytes.
x_justification.why_present: Allows customer-controlled re-identification and key rotation auditing.
x_justification.zero_content: Key identifier slug only; never key material (DE-004).

session_key.description: Primary key: 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym of the session identity.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required primary key on every session row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym over (org, endpoint_scope, canonical_harness, native_session) using the endpoint pseudonymization key; fixes F13 where seal_identifier left ordinary IDs in plaintext.
x_justification.why_present: Primary join key across sessions, invocations, tool_calls, usage, and outcomes within fact-export-v1.
x_justification.zero_content: 64-char hex HMAC digest; never raw native_session (DE-004, F13).

session_status.description: Lifecycle status of the session at snapshot capture time.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Uses 'unknown' when session lifecycle state cannot be determined from source records.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 6-value enum.
x_justification.why_present: Tracks session progression across snapshots; an 'active' session in sequence N can be replaced by 'completed' in sequence N+1.

signal_source.description: Observation surface that produced the session record.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required closed enum identifying the capture path.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 3-value enum.
x_justification.why_present: Distinguishes harness session logs from hook IPC and native OTLP ingress (A4, A5a).

source_generation.description: Monotonic ingestion generation number for source_id.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required positive integer (>= 1).
x_justification.pseudonymization: Monotonic integer counter.
x_justification.why_present: Defines the replacement scope boundary for within-generation updates and generation supersession.

source_id.description: Pseudonymized 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 identifier of the ingestion source.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required on every row.
x_justification.pseudonymization: 64-char hex HMAC-SHA256 digest of the source descriptor (F13); never a raw filesystem path.
x_justification.why_present: Scopes replacement manifests and coverage denominators to a specific ingestion source.
x_justification.zero_content: Hex HMAC digest; never a file path (DE-004, F5).

started_at_us.description: Session start timestamp in UTC microseconds since Unix epoch when observed.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Non-null when timestamp_status is 'complete' or 'start_only'; null iff timestamp_status == 'not_observable'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Numeric UTC timestamp.
x_justification.why_present: Anchors session time-window queries and epoch overlap window checks.

team.description: Team scope slug bound into K_link derivation per link-id-v1 §3.1.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Required non-empty ASCII slug.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Administrative team scope slug (e.g. 'platform-eng'); never an individual developer name or email.
x_justification.why_present: Enforces team-scoped access control (EN5b) and team-scoped HKDF key isolation (link-id-v1 §7.2).
x_justification.zero_content: Team slug only; no personal identifiers or emails (DE-004, F5).

timestamp_status.description: Explicit completeness status for started_at_us and ended_at_us.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Governs whether started_at_us and ended_at_us are non-null.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed 3-value enum.
x_justification.why_present: Eliminates null ambiguity on session boundary timestamps.

unlinked_reason.description: Normative reason code from link-id-v1 §4.3/§5 when agent.session.link_id == 'unlinked'; null when linked.

x_justification.missingness_semantics: Must be null when agent.session.link_id is a 64-hex digest, and must be a non-null link-id-v1 reason code when agent.session.link_id == 'unlinked'.
x_justification.pseudonymization: Closed vocabulary of 9 link-id-v1 diagnostic reason codes.
x_justification.why_present: Preserves exact root cause for unlinked sessions so coverage denominators can separate synthetic frames from configuration errors.

title: fact-export-v1 sessions table row
x_invariants: timestamp_status == 'complete' <=> (started_at_us != null && ended_at_us != null && ended_at_us >= started_at_us)
lineage_status == 'evidenced' <=> (is_root == false && parent_session_key != null && parent_session_key != session_key && lineage_relation != 'root')
